title: Capsule Review: pretrained frozen MobileNetV3 full-field features in training-only Galar examination-disjoint development
role: Post-hoc exploratory comparison; original data and prior compact CNN failure results have been examined. Not blinded validation, clinical development, or physician evidence preservation.
scientific_question: Does one fixed pretrained full-field image representation + training-fold-only regularized linear blood-label classifier generalize across 14 whole held-out fitting examinations better than the previously frozen from-scratch pooled weighted CNN at the same 512 reference-image review budgets?

sources.only_permitted_validation: 512 source-chronological label-blind reference images per examination, *entire exam omitted from its fold's fit*; enriched-only images strictly train-fold-only
sources.original_source_zip_sha256: From verified existing ten source-image package receipts in docs/GALAR_EXAM_CV_SPEC.json, checked again per original image byte digest

feature_extractor.backbone: torchvision.models.mobilenet_v3_small ImageNet IMAGENET1K_V1; torchvision 0.25 and torch 2.10 CPU used
feature_extractor.feature: Last convolutional feature output + adaptive global average pool; 576 dimensions
feature_extractor.input: Original PNG -> EXIF transpose -> RGB -> deterministic 160×160 bicubic full-field direct resize; do NOT center crop; float32 /255; normalize ImageNet mean [0.485,0.456,0.406], std [0.229,0.224,0.225]
feature_extractor.frozen: No backbone gradient, model.eval; no data-augmentation or calibration; no checkpoint selection
feature_extractor.extraction: Once per 10,123 verified original PNGs into private feature matrix. Check SHA256 of every source PNG against verified old/new manifests and compare original exam, frame, reference role and label to prior private metadata fingerprint.
feature_extractor.cache: Private only, original source identity and metadata never in Git

linear_probe.algorithm: sklearn LogisticRegression with solver lbfgs and L2 penalty, C=0.1, class_weight='balanced', fit_intercept=true, max_iter=300, tol=1e-6, random_state=37
linear_probe.scaling: StandardScaler(with_mean=true,with_std=true) fitted only on training-fold feature vectors; no heldout feature-stat leakage
linear_probe.fit_policy: Fit 3 independent fold-only probes, each uses all allowed fitting-only image rows outside its entire heldout examinations. No labels from heldout fold influence fitting or feature standardization.
linear_probe.source_positivity: The new fitting source unions contain deliberate blood-positive enrichment. These are training data, not prevalence or clinical review-efficiency estimates.
linear_probe.hyperparameter_selection: No search or post-hoc C/threshold/crop/architecture changes. If convergence warning arises, preserve and report without silently increasing iterations.
linear_probe.saved_values: Persist each scaler mean/scale, probe coefficients/intercept, feature cache fingerprint and individual predictions privately, not Git

comparison.reference: Already merged and immutable prior pooled_weighted compact CNN from scratch, Galar 14 exam 3-fold study; compare exact same heldout exam IDs/source reference roles
comparison.primary: Per-examination ROC-AUC, descriptive macro mean on the same 6 positive-reference examinations with >=10 positives (1,7,25,27,29,30); paired comparison to previous fixed pooled CNN
comparison.secondary: Per-examination AP and ROC-AUC for all 11 explicitly positive exams (1-9 positives flagged unreliable), image hits among exactly K=51/128/256/512 reviewed reference frames by model, prior pooled CNN and deterministic uniform
comparison.negative_exam_policy: 3,5,8 are explicitly blood-negative-labelled but may contain other pathology; per-examination ROC-AUC/AP undefined null; report score distribution and forced review workload, never call false clinical diagnoses
comparison.no_source_run_metric: Sparse reference input is not sufficient to claim actual original annotation-run/lesion recall from model predictions
comparison.uncertainty: No image-bootstrapped confidence intervals or claims of verified independent patients; 14 exams small and preexamined
comparison.decision: No model promotion or tuning based on inspected outcomes. Results interpreted as exploratory fit-candidate ranking, not external validation

artifacts: Commit immutable protocol, source-integrity/test code and nonidentifying aggregated per-examination outcomes. Keep images, frame IDs, original labels, fitted coefficients, saved per-image predictions and pretrained weight bytes outside Git.
